status: bounded physical plausibility model; scenario test, not a GCM or ice-sheet simulation

scientific_basis.use: Earth analog for plausible glacial-interglacial amplitude and recurrence only; Erde does not inherit Earth's exact chronology

scientific_basis.topic: old arc plus later isthmus emergence
scientific_basis.source: O'Dea et al. 2016 Formation of the Isthmus of Panama
scientific_basis.use: mechanism analog for long-lived arc/terrane crust preceding final terrestrial closure

scientific_basis.source: Brumm et al. 2010 and later Flores work
scientific_basis.use: supports genuine water barriers around 1 Ma; does not establish a universal safe crossing distance
supports strong mountain glaciation at roughly 40-50S while topography and precipitation gradients leave spatially heterogeneous ice margins
supports long-lived localized refugia but not broad productive human habitat in polar interiors

JX1_emergence.interpretation: JX1 crust is old; final emergence occurs millions of years before human-route requirements rather than being equated with crustal collision.

northern_approach.interpretation: Synthetic Erde states are amplitude-bounded scenarios, not transplanted Earth dates. H06 and H10 contain strong exposure intervals; H07 retains occasional narrow exposure consistent with rare recontacts.
northern_approach.pass_condition: at least two H06 sample states <= -75 m; all H10 sample states <= -75 m; H07 contains both exposed and unexposed sample states

eastern_shelf_initial.reason: Repeated 1.0-0.6 Ma founding waves do not require an all-land route, but leaving a ~188 km first open-water leg is an unnecessary plausibility burden when old local terranes can shorten the route without destroying island isolation.

eastern_shelf_repaired.pass_condition: all crossing legs <= 80 km; every sill remains submerged by at least 150 m at -130 m lowstand; both stepping terranes have freshwater catchments
eastern_shelf_repaired.interpretation: The repair preserves mandatory water crossings while making repeated colonization less dependent on an exceptional single voyage.

requirements.H02: connected route need only exist during suitable pre-1.9-1.7 Ma intervals
requirements.H08: productive peripheral network may fragment during maxima but cannot disappear

C4_peripheral_refugia.pass_condition: corridor remains outside polar interior; warm-phase habitat fraction >= 0.7; cold-phase refugia_count >= 2; cold-phase lowland ice occupation < 0.5
C4_peripheral_refugia.interpretation: A midlatitude maritime foreland with an inland mountain/ice divide is more defensible than the old ~60S exit. It does not imply the whole C4 margin is ice-free.

C3_internal_filter.pass_condition: at least one state permits limited interior contact and at least one state strongly restricts it; no state creates simultaneous easy interior and coastal bypasses
C3_internal_filter.interpretation: Relief and hydroclimate can provide intermittent west-east contact without changing C3's coastline.

overall.geometry_change_required: add two old eastern stepping terranes; no continental silhouette or junction redesign required
remaining_unresolved: full local relative sea-level calculation including glacio-isostasy/geoid effects
ocean-current and voyage simulation for eastern crossings
